name: Images and Laws of Cube-Intersection Operators
statement: For median $G$, $Q_0(G)$ is Helly. For every $k\ge1$, the possible graphs $Q_k(G)$ are exactly the clique graphs, with $Q_1(G)=C(G^e)$. For all $k,\ell\ge0$, $Q_k(G)=Q_{k+\ell}(G\square Q_\ell)$. The possible $Q_{m2}(G)$ are exactly the diamond-free graphs, and $Q_{m2}(G\square H)=Q_{m2}(G)\square Q_{m2}(H)$; no analogous fixed-$Q_k$ product identity holds in general.
